The gate passes with a true exit code of 0. All work is complete.

## Summary

**Gate result:** `TMPDIR=/tmp/es2-glm node docs/diagrams/tools/diagram-index-gen.cjs docs/diagrams --check --render --jobs 8` → exit 0, 20 topics, 106/106 diagrams parsed and rendered by mmdc, no width violations.

**Diagrams repaired:** all 36 listed findings, across 19 topic files in six areas (corpus, delivery, dense, extract, mermaid, model). **Blocks added: 0** — every repair fit inside the existing `sequenceDiagram` under its own heading, so no continuation sections were needed.

**How each class of finding was repaired** (edits confined to the listed mermaid fences; all `path:line` citations carried over):

- **Class/type relationships drawn as messages** (COR-01.3, COR-04.1, MOD-03.1, MER-01.1, DEL-01.4, EXT-06.1, EXT-06.3, MOD-01.1): arrows replaced by `Note over A,B` lines stating the original `*--` / `-->` / `..>` relation verbatim with its citation; DEL-01.4's nine reversed "depends" arrows became notes with the direction the manifests state, and its `autonumber` was dropped.
- **Exclusive outcomes drawn as a sequence** (COR-03.3 Clean/Missing entries, COR-06.3 pack vs shard, EXT-01.2 src/bin·main.rs vs the tests/examples/benches check, EXT-02.1 trait-impl vs foreign owner, EXT-02.2's eight match arms, EXT-05.2's early-return first-segment branches): restructured into `alt`/`else` so one run takes exactly one arm; only the library-crate outcomes now reach the target-kind check.
- **Iteration that must terminate** (COR-06.3): `TopicOverBudget` now sits in a `break` inside the shard loop, so the loop ends as `pack.rs:318` returns.
- **Unordered fan-outs serialised** (COR-02.5's four views, EXT-04.5's two label chains, EXT-03.7's three environment entries, DEL-02.6's coverage+failure from one verify run, DEN-01.6's five defect→fix chains, MOD-01.4's name/field inputs): redrawn as `par` arms (fixes are notes in DEN-01.6 — no reply edges back to the read; `autonumber` dropped there).
- **Order/call claims the original never made** (DEL-01.1 job hand-offs, COR-02.3 "field edges first", EXT-06.1's token→section order and key context, MOD-03.5's Return "interior", MER-01.2's escape_text→escape_type direction, DEN-01.4's unconditional five-level climb): removed or restated as the subsumption/layering/climb-driven-by-collision-check the original and cited code state.
- **Mis-attributed senders** (COR-05.3, COR-06.1 refusals/packs, MOD-02.5's model verdicts, MOD-02.2's truncated digest, EXT-05.6's shadowed type, EXT-04.3's None policy, EXT-02.4's kept paren-comma): the CLI/check now performs what `main.rs`/`check.rs` show it performing; dropped outcomes stay as notes and never reach participants the original didn't connect them to.
- **Label/citation corrections** (COR-03.4 "not readable or not relative to the root", COR-05.4 "the gates" grouping removed, MOD-01.4 empty-name case restored and the package field given its own participant, MOD-01.6 "shared id builder", MOD-03.3 `path.rs:49` back on the absolute check).

**Nothing else touched:** no prose, headings, REGISTER/README/COVERAGE/DECISIONS-TIMELINE, config, tools, `.original/`, or any unlisted diagram (verified by mtimes — only the 19 topic files changed). Probe files live in `.scratch/repair/`; temp renders went to `/tmp/es2-glm`. Nothing was left unrepaired.
